about:
ICON Injection Molding, Inc. was founded in 2001 in Phoenix, Arizona, by three brothers—Danny, Philip, and Steve Kleitsch. The brothers had worked in their father’s injection molding and tooling shop since the late 1970s, learning the craft of fine tool building and customer relationships. After their father sold the business, they launched their own family-owned and operated company, naming it ICON after becoming the first custom molder in Arizona to adopt electric-hybrid molding machines.

The company provides custom plastic injection molding solutions, including tooling, machining, assembly, and secondary operations. Its facility houses 42 presses ranging from 15 to 720 tons, with capabilities for clean room molding, overmolding, rotary (vertical) molding, and scientific molding supported by automation. A quality lab equipped with Keyence 3-D inspection enables tolerances as tight as 0.00008 inch, and the team conducts capability studies (CPK), Gage R&R, first article inspections, and IQ/OQ/PQ validations.

ICON serves global markets through both domestic production and offshore strategic partnerships, offering customers the choice of “Made in USA” parts or cost-effective international sourcing. Its customers include original equipment manufacturers and supply chain partners who value responsiveness and flexibility, as noted in testimonials describing ICON as an extension of their manufacturing teams.

The company’s differentiation rests on a scientific, engineering-based approach that emphasizes problem prevention over detection. With over 100 combined years of industry experience among the Kleitsch family and staff, ICON maintains ISO 9001:2015 certification and a commitment to “Excellence from Art to Part,” delivering stable processes, low scrap rates, and world-class quality documentation.
